messages.snippet: Dear Sarah, The case management conference in Bracken Group v Calderwood Industries (CL-2025-000412)
messages.subject: Bracken v Calderwood — CMC listing
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sarah,

The case management conference in Bracken Group v Calderwood Industries (CL-2025-000412) has been listed for the week of 19 May. Could we have a con beforehand to finalise the list of issues and disclosure proposals? My clerk will offer dates.

Kind regards,
Catherine Rosenthal KC
Eldon Chambers
